CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the identified content was reliably present.

COD.rationale: Identified content (red positions) and an explicit organization/presentation record (origin) are both present and separately attributed for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: Report contains processing-state labels (candidate, inherited_current, executed_branch_claim) but no explicit attention/allocation phrasing clearly linked to content organization; therefore ambiguous.

C.rationale: The text identifies represented content (colour-labeled cell coordinates) for a named referent and time.

D.rationale: Content identification (red coordinates) is presented separately from a status/organization field (origin) for the same referent/time.

O.rationale: An explicit origin/representation record states how/when the content is represented (represented_time/record_time) for the named referent.
